en.headline: Outdoor and Tech Light Expo opens today at AsiaWorld-Expo
en.dek: The HKTDC fair runs through Thursday for industry visitors, featuring smart outdoor lighting solutions and concurrent with the autumn lighting fair starting tomorrow.
body: The Hong Kong Trade Development Council’s International Outdoor and Tech Light Expo opens today at AsiaWorld-Expo on Lantau, running through Thursday.

Organisers said the event is open to industry professionals aged 18 and over. Opening hours on Monday are 10:30 a.m. to 6 p.m., with registration available from 10 a.m. Pre-registered visitors with electronic badges enter free; others pay HK$100 on site.

The fair focuses on outdoor, industrial and technical lighting, including smart pole solutions and green technology hubs. It runs alongside the Hong Kong International Lighting Fair (Autumn Edition), which begins tomorrow at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai.
According to HKTDC materials, previous editions drew exhibitors from mainland China, Hong Kong and Germany, with buyers from over 100 countries and regions.

zh.headline: 香港國際戶外及科技照明博覽今日亞洲博覽館開幕
zh.dek: 貿發局主辦的業界展覽至周四舉行，展示智能戶外照明方案，入場限18歲或以上業內人士，明日起同期有秋季燈飾展。
body: 香港貿易發展局主辦的香港國際戶外及科技照明博覽今日於大嶼山亞洲國際博覽館開幕，一連四日至周四結束。
主辦方表示，展覽只供18歲或以上的業內人士參觀。周一開放時間為上午10時30分至下午6時，買家登記由上午10時起。已預先登記並持電子入場證者免費入場，現場登記收費100港元。
展覽聚焦戶外、工業及技術照明，設有智慧燈杆方案及綠色技術交流區。展覽與明日起在灣仔香港會議展覽中心舉行的香港國際秋季燈飾展同期舉行。
據貿發局資料，過往屆次有來自中國內地、香港及德國的參展商，吸引逾100個國家及地區的買家。
